libs.note: BH-9987: a ticket reaches review only after a live probe of its primary screen. bin/board-closeout.sh moves an in-app PR_CREATED to in_progress, not review. bin/merged-ticket-advance.sh moves a client-filed ticket to review after the deploy audit; when the audit is not PASS it first makes one unauthenticated GET of <prod> + the first static route of the plan's QA screens (else /), and holds the ticket (no comment, no move, skip reason no-live-probe, one alert per ticket and token) unless the answer is served or signin. Applied through lib_env_apply review-probe. Doc: docs/notes/2026-11-24-BH-9987-review-needs-live-probe.md.

knobs.zero_means: today's behavior: review at PR open, and review after a merge with no screen opened
knobs.note: 1 turns the gate on. Anything but 0 reads 1. Read as ${REVIEW_PROBE_REQUIRE:-1} in rp_required.
The --max-time of the one probe GET. A primary screen slower than this is a hold, not a pass. A non-number reads 20; values are clamped to 1..120. Read as ${REVIEW_PROBE_TIMEOUT_S:-20} in rp_probe.

knobs.zero_means: no redirect is followed: any 3xx answer is an error (a hold)
knobs.note: The --max-redirs of the one probe GET. A chain longer than this comes back as error, which holds the ticket. A non-number reads 5. Read as ${REVIEW_PROBE_MAX_REDIRS:-5} in rp_probe.
